author: mmusich
body:
#### PR description:

This PR is a follow-up to https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52267.
It contains the code changes necessary to create the plots for [this DP note proposal](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1746106/#30-pre-app-run-3-ngt-optimal-c).
It adds to the `EcalLaserAPDPNRatios` PayloadInspector:
- history plots of the p1, p2 and p3 laser corrections for one tag or two tags (`EcalLaserAPDPNRatiosP{1,2,3}{Mean,RMS}History{OneTag,TwoTags}`), with EB, EE- and EE+ on the same canvas
- history plots of the crystal-by-crystal difference between two tags, either absolute or relative to the first tag (`EcalLaserAPDPNRatiosP{1,2,3}DiffHistory` and `EcalLaserAPDPNRatiosP{1,2,3}PercentDiffHistory`). For each point the plot shows the median over crystals and the 1684% quantile band, so a few outlier crystals do not bias it. The difference is evaluated on the union of the IOV boundaries of the two tags, so a run-based tag can be compared with a lumisection-based one.
- CMS publication style for the new plots and for the `HistCompare` plots. The labels are set with the `cmsLabel` and `rightLabel` input parameters:
  - `cmsLabel` is empty by default (no CMS label); `cmsLabel=Preliminary` gives "CMS Preliminary" and `cmsLabel=CMS` gives "CMS" alone
  - `rightLabel` defaults to "13.6 TeV"
- a unit test, `CondCore/EcalPlugins/test/testEcalLaserAPDPNRatiosPayloadInspector.cpp`, which runs all the classes of the plugin

#### PR validation:

The new unit test `testEcalLaserAPDPNRatiosPayloadInspector` was compiled and run in `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-01-2300`. It uses the tags `EcalLaserAPDPNRatios_weekly_hlt` and `EcalLaserAPDPNRatios_prompt_v3_inRunLSIoVs`.
The plots for the DP note were produced with `getPayloadData.py`, using the same tag pair over two ranges:
- 2025: runs 398675398858
- 2026: runs 401623403937

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport, no backport foreseen.
